# Potential Data Deletion Severity

The fixture deletes repositories and all their child records if their slugs match specific patterns, relying on correctly defined test repo slugs. Any non-test repository accidentally given such a slug could be irreversibly deleted during test cleanup.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/conftest.py` — `tests.conftest._cleanup_test_repos`
